SELECT dp.ticker, dsb.qty FROM domestic_stock_balance dsb JOIN domestic_product dp ON dp.domestic_product_id = dsb.domestic_product_id WHERE ORDER BY dsb.domestic_stock_balance_id

SELECT dp.ticker, dp.name, dp.sector_name AS sectorName, dp.type, dsb.status, dsb.qty, dsb.avg_purchase_price AS avgPurchasePrice FROM domestic_stock_balance dsb JOIN domestic_product dp ON dp.domestic_product_id = dsb.domestic_product_id WHERE ORDER BY dsb.qty * dsb.avg_purchase_price DESC, dsb.domestic_stock_balance_id
